summary: The polar hint gives a nice start, but the famous small deserts (Mojave, Atacama, Namib, Thar) eat every life, and the Australian entry is hard to type. Fix the aliases, then run it as a Blitz.
reasons: Casual classic: Sahara, Antarctica, Gobi, Arctic, Kalahari and Arabian, then Mojave, Atacama, Namib, Sonoran and Thar each cost a life. Out at 6/10.
#5 'Great Australian Desert' is not a name people use; 'outback', 'australian outback' and 'australia' are not recognized, while 'Great Victoria' (part of it) costs a life at #13.
In Blitz those famous small deserts score, so 12 of 16 casual names count; the pool is only 38 deep.
fixes: Add 'Outback', 'Australian Outback' and 'Australian deserts' as aliases of Great Australian Desert (the alias 'Australian Outback deserts' exists but the short forms do not match).

The top 10 counts the Great Australian Desert as a whole, yet its parts (Great Victoria, Great Sandy, Gibson, Tanami, Simpson, Little Sandy, Strzelecki) are separate ranked entries, so naming one costs a life. Make them alias choices of Great Australian Desert in classic, or drop the parts.
Add 'Rub al Khali' and 'Empty Quarter' as aliases of Arabian Desert; they are currently not recognized.
Ranked entries that are not deserts by name: 'Colorado Plateau', 'Columbia Basin', 'Ustyurt Plateau', 'Ladakh'. Check the source rows and drop or rename them.
